text:
maya: Heads-up — Titancorp onboarding: reserved pool ready (commit: 18k RPS equiv). Need a short ops runbook + autoscale policy review before handoff. Can someone grab runbook authoring and the smoke/load windows?

omar: I can review autoscale policy. Quick Q: do we prefer aggressive scale-up for short bursts or smoother ramp? Also need their expected concurrency distribution.

leo: I can write the runbook and run smoke. Prefer smooth ramp for customer stability, but allow fast emergency scale-up path (manual override).

maya: Customer expectation: p95 <= 200ms for chat-gen, 120ms for single-turn text-gen. Concurrency: typical bursts ~1500 concurrent requests, steady ~600. They asked for a 3hr validation window with a 1hr soak.

katie: I'm the CS lead on Titancorp — thumbs up on those SLOs. Please include a short note for them about warmup billing and a contact for immediate rollback.

ops-bot: Ephemeral token requested by leo. Token id tok-981b created, expires in 3.5 hours.

omar: Draft policy idea: metrics = [queue_length, gpu_mem_pct, avg_latency]. Triggers: scale-up when queue_length > 200 OR gpu_mem_pct > 78% OR p95_latency > 170ms for 30s. scale-down when all under thresholds for 3m. Add cooldowns: up=20s, down=90s. Also set max replicas=40, min=6.

leo: Runbook outline: 1) Pre-checks (KV prime, model cache warm), 2) Smoke (15m at 10% load), 3) Ramp (45m linear to peak), 4) Soak (60m at peak), 5) Post-checks (latency histograms, fallback events, OOM logs). Will include exact k6/vegeta commands.

maya: Include a step to test the fallback routing to "redwood-fallback" model; we need to confirm that routes are configured and warm. Also capture any "rate-limit-exceeded" events in logs.

leo: Agreed. Sample k6 command I'll include: `k6 run --vus 1200 --duration 45m --env TOKEN=$TOKEN titancorp_ramp.js` then `k6 run --vus 1800 --duration 60m titancorp_soak.js`. I'll attach traffic CSV and a small harness that rotates prompts and tags request-size.

omar: One more suggestion — for batching tune set target tokens-per-batch = 5 for short, 7 for medium, 3 for long (to avoid latency spikes). Also enable AI runtime's dynamic KV prefetch for top-50 prefixes.

katie: I'll confirm customer can be present for the first 30m of soak for subjective quality check. Also they want a weekly sync post-onboard for 4 weeks to capture feedback and any jitter.

ops-bot: Runbook doc created: doc-55811 (private). Run scheduled: 2025-08-12 02:00-05:00 UTC.

leo: I'll post PR with runbook + k6 scripts by EOD PST. Will include a checklist for oncall and the rollback play.

maya: Perfect. Omar — please paste the final autoscale YAML in the PR so SRE can review. @katie — will send Titancorp note with the schedule and the preflight checklist. Thanks all.
